name: South Bay Galleria
summary: 3-story mall offers a range of well-known retail shops, restaurants & a light-filled center atrium.
description: South Bay Galleria is a premier shopping destination in Redondo Beach featuring 3 levels of over 140 retailers including anchor stores Macy's and Kohl's, plus an AMC Dine-In Theatre. The center offers a diverse mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment options with extended holiday hours and a commitment to serving the South Bay community.
demographics: South Bay Galleria serves a diverse, affluent South Bay community with a mix of young professionals, families, and empty nesters, primarily in the upper-middle income brackets typical of the Redondo Beach, Manhattan Beach, and Hermosa Beach areas. The trade area attracts residents with median household incomes ranging from $80,000 to $150,000+, with a strong preference for value-oriented shopping combined with entertainment and dining experiences. Visitors tend to be between 25-54 years old, seeking a convenient, multi-purpose destination that balances mainstream retail brands with family-friendly entertainment like movies and casual dining.
